sentences.en: To my regret, his was nothing but a short-lived triumph.
sentences.zh: 令我遗憾的是，他的胜利只是昙花一现。

sentences.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
sentences.zh: 只要好人无所作为，邪恶就会得逞。

sentences.en: The result of globalization is the triumph of unique thought.
sentences.zh: 全球化的结果是独特思想的胜利。

senses.zh: 胜利；巨大的成就；（成功的）典范
